description: Source code for AudioProfileVectorHelper functions in Android audio policy management, including profile sorting, addition, validation, and configuration matching.

methods.name: sortAudioProfiles
methods.description: Sorts a vector of audio profiles based on format comparison.

methods.name: addAudioProfileAndSort
methods.description: Adds an audio profile to the vector and sorts the list.

methods.name: getAudioProfileForFormat
methods.description: Retrieves the first audio profile matching a specific format.

methods.name: setSampleRatesForAudioProfiles
methods.description: Sets sample rates for profiles with a specific format, creating new profiles if dynamic rate.

methods.name: setChannelsForAudioProfiles
methods.description: Sets channel masks for profiles with a specific format, creating new profiles if dynamic channels.

methods.name: addProfilesForFormats
methods.description: Adds new profiles for a list of formats based on a dynamic profile.

methods.name: addDynamicAudioProfileAndSort
methods.description: Adds a dynamic audio profile to the list after validation and avoiding duplicates.

methods.name: appendAudioProfiles
methods.description: Appends one vector of audio profiles to another.

methods.name: checkExact
methods.description: Checks if an audio profile exactly matches given sampling rate, channel mask, and format.

methods.name: checkCompatibleSamplingRate
methods.description: Finds the closest supported sampling rate to the desired one within allowed ratios.

methods.name: checkCompatibleChannelMask
methods.description: Checks and finds the best matching channel mask supported by a profile.

methods.name: checkExactProfile
methods.description: Verifies if any profile in a vector exactly matches specified parameters.

methods.name: checkCompatibleProfile
methods.description: Checks if any profile in a vector is compatible with specified parameters, adjusting as needed.

methods.name: intersectFilterAndOrder
methods.description: Finds intersection of two vectors ordered by a specified preference.

methods.name: intersectAndOrder
methods.description: Finds intersection of two vectors ordered by a comparator.

methods.name: findBestMatchingOutputConfig
methods.description: Finds the best matching output configuration based on supported profiles, formats, channels, and sample rates.
